records.preparation: Prepare with running water. The manufacturer documents 1+1 for a reusable working solution and 1+3 for a one-shot working solution.
records.reuseInstructions: At 1+1 the working solution can develop up to 15 films; increase development time by 15% every 3 films. At 1+3 discard after use.
records.capacityText: At 1+1, one litre working solution develops up to 15 films.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Use concentrate within 4 months in a completely full container or 2 months in a partially full container.
records.sourceTitle: ARS-IMAGO FE ECO Film Developer Datasheet

records.preparation: Standard replenisher is 1 part A + 1 part B + 2 parts water; modified replenisher 1+1+5 is also documented. Add ILFOTEC RT RAPID Starter to turn replenisher into working-strength developer.
records.reuseInstructions: Designed for replenished roller-transport and short-leader processors; use process control and replenishment. It is not recommended for spiral tanks, dishes, dip-and-dunk, rotary tubes or continuous long-leader processing.
records.capacityText: The 2x5 litre kit makes 20 litres of 1+1+2 working-strength solution and provides replenishment for about 1100 135-36 films; at 1+1+5 it makes 35 litres and replenishment for about 1925 135-36 films.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Full unopened concentrate stored at 5-20 C: 2 years.
records.shelfLifeOpened: Once opened, use concentrate completely within 3 months; keep bottles tightly sealed until use.
records.shelfLifeWorking: Replenished developer: general replacement guide 6-12 months in the process tank. Unreplenished working strength: up to 6 months full tightly capped, 2 months under floating lid, 1 month half-full tightly capped.
records.sourceTitle: ILFORD ILFOTEC RT RAPID Technical Information

records.preparation: Dilute 1+4; the current manufacturer example uses 52 ml RLS + 208 ml water for 260 ml working solution at 24 C.
records.capacityText: 500 ml RLS concentrate is sufficient for approximately 19 films.
